status: implemented (KitShop + KShopLayout in AgentScripts/MajibangBuilder.cs); KitBuild dry-run compiles; KitValidate test .planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/kit-preview/full/shop-test.json accepts all 12 fixture keys (13,318 tris incl. cooler/gondola products) and rejects an unknown key as an element error.

params.openEdges: [int] edges besides `front` with no wall panel, skirting, joint or collider. Out-of-range index = element error.
params.back: int edge for the backWall finish (explicit value used as given); default = farthest edge from the front excluding `front` and openEdges (unchanged when openEdges is empty).
params.layout: [{fixture, at, heading, length?, depth?, height?, elevation?}] replaces the automatic fixtures when present (walls/ceiling/downlights/light unchanged; `fixtures: false` still skips all fixtures). heading must be non-zero. `length` = extent across heading; `elevation` = base above the floor (menu: board centre height, default 2.15).

fixtures.tableSet: KTableSet at `at`, chairs left/right of heading
fixtures.menu: KMenuBoards, at = wall-face point, heading out of the wall, length 3.2
fixtures.shelf: KShelf one-sided, at = back line centre, length 2, height 2.0, depth .4, 5 levels
fixtures.gondola: KShelf two-sided, at = centre line, length 2, height 1.5, depth .4, 4 levels
fixtures.cooler: KCooler, at = cabinet centre, length 3 (height fixed 2.0, depth .6)
fixtures.bakeryShelf: KShelf one-sided Kit_Bread, at = back line centre, length 2, height 1.6, depth .45, 4 levels

backwardCompatible: without openEdges/back/layout the code path is unchanged
